title: Cloud
unavailable: Cloud isn't available in this session: its engine (lordos-rclone) isn't installed or isn't running.

freedSkipped.one: {size} freed; {count} item stays (open, kept or waiting to go up)
freedSkipped.other: {size} freed; {count} items stay (open, kept or waiting to go up)

freeBelow: Free up space when this computer has less than
empty.title: Your cloud storage, in Files
empty.body: Add a drive, a server or a bucket. Its files show in Files under Cloud and come down when you open them.
service.title: Service
service.private: only LordOS can reach it, on no network address
bandwidthHint: Cloud's transfers run at low priority, so they never slow down the desktop.
about.title: About rclone
about.license: MIT License, the same as LordOS
about.hint: rclone is the open source engine LordOS uses for Cloud. It runs for you alone and listens on no network address.
space.title: Space
space.noQuota: This storage has no quota: what is used is measured once a day.
space.emptyTrash: Empty the trash on the website
state.signin: Sign in again to keep syncing
share.anyone: Anyone with the link can view it
share.provider: To share with specific people, set a password or let them edit, use Open on Website: those options are the provider's.
link.unsupported: This storage has no public links. Open on Website shares it there.
link.failed: The link couldn't be made. Try again in a moment.
links.title: Shared links
offline.title: {name} isn't on this computer
offline.body: The cloud can't be reached right now. It opens once the network is back, or keep it on this computer next time.
notify.signinTitle: “{name}” needs you to sign in again
notify.signinBody: The provider stopped accepting the saved sign-in. Changes made here wait on this computer until you sign in. Files you kept still open.
notify.conflictBody: {file} changed in {account} while this computer was offline. The cloud's version keeps the name; yours is next to it as “{kept}”.

notify.fullBody.one: {used} of {total} used. {count} changed file can't go up. Free space in the account or choose files to keep only on this computer.
notify.fullBody.other: {used} of {total} used. {count} changed files can't go up. Free space in the account or choose files to keep only on this computer.

addFolderTitle: Keep a folder of “{name}” on this computer
inKeyring: Its sign-in is in the keyring
removeHint: Removing it deletes nothing in the cloud: only its copy on this computer and its sign-in.

removePending.one: {count} change made here hasn't gone up yet. Removing the account now loses it.
removePending.other: {count} changes made here haven't gone up yet. Removing the account now loses them.

ownClient.title: Use my own client ID
ownClient.hint: Sign in with an app you registered with the provider. Its ID and secret go to the keyring.
add.title: Add a Cloud Account
add.subtitle: Its files show in Files under Cloud. Passwords and sign-ins stay in the keyring.
name.chars: A name can't have “/”, “\” or start with a dot.
cred.noteServer: The certificate is checked first. One the system doesn't trust shows its fingerprint, and only that one is kept for this server.
cred.noteObject: Keys go to the keyring. Object storage has no quota: Settings shows what is used, measured once a day.
cred.noteCrypt: Names and contents are encrypted on this computer before they go up. Without the password, nobody can read them, LordOS included.
signin.title: Sign in to {provider} in your browser
signin.body: The sign-in page opened in your default browser. When you allow access there, “{name}” appears in Files under Cloud.
signin.expired: The time to sign in ran out.
signin.rclone: Signing in uses rclone, the open source engine LordOS uses for Cloud. The provider's page will ask you to allow rclone.
signin.local: LordOS waits for the page's answer on this computer only (127.0.0.1), and only during the sign-in.
readyBody: Files come down when you open them.
